steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab too.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Capitol in Filter environments. Click United States Capitol, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the walk
steps.html: Find an open space near the Capitol. Put the 5 models in a line, like a walk: White House, Washington Monument, Lincoln Memorial, Jefferson Memorial, Statue of Liberty.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until your whole diorama fits. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Leave room between the monuments, so visitors can stop and remember at each one.

vr.full: One photo that shows all 5 monuments in your holiday walk.

studio.title: The Holiday Calendar
studio.look: A calendar with all 12 months. Five holiday cards are waiting. Each card tells its date. Then you tell if it is a loud-and-bright day or a quiet-and-serious day.
studio.do: Step 1: tap the holiday's month. Step 2: tap the kind of day it is.

labels.step2: What kind of day is it?

game.miss: Not that one. Read the card again.
game.done: The calendar is full! Some days we celebrate, and some days we remember. Both are needed.

cards.name: Martin Luther King Jr. Day
cards.ok: Yes! A quieter day to remember Dr. King and serve others.
cards.miss: This day is for remembering Dr. King and serving others.

cards.name: Memorial Day
cards.honors: It honors people who died serving in the U.S.
cards.ok: Yes! A quiet, serious day of remembering.
cards.miss: Families visit graves on this day. Is that loud or quiet?

cards.name: Flag Day
cards.honors: It honors the American flag, adopted on this day in 1777.
cards.ok: Yes! A bright day to celebrate the flag.
cards.miss: People proudly fly flags on this day. Is that a celebration?

cards.name: Independence Day
cards.honors: It celebrates the Declaration of Independence in 1776.
cards.ok: Yes! The big, loud, bright one.
cards.miss: Fireworks and parades! Is that loud or quiet?

cards.name: Veterans Day
cards.honors: It honors all the men and women who have served in the U.S.
cards.ok: Yes! A serious day to thank and remember veterans.
cards.miss: This day thanks people who served. Is it a serious day?

frames.lead: Pick one holiday. What does it honor?
Why do countries set aside special days?
frames.starter: Countries set aside special days so that ...

studio.full: All five holidays are on the calendar, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
